description: Validates that campaign components are scheduled during platform-specific golden-hour windows — the peak-velocity windows where early engagement carries maximum algorithmic weight. Golden hour = first 60 min after publish (LinkedIn/Substack) or 30 min (X/Instagram). Gate is advisory: all findings are WARNs (wrong timing degrades performance, does not invalidate the campaign).

schema.scheduled_at_field: ISO 8601 datetime on each component (source, hub, spokes[*]). Optional — gate WARNs if absent.

litmus: Run HOW.py with campaign_file — exit 0=all scheduled components in golden windows, exit 2=WARN (outside windows, bad days, tight spacing, or no scheduled_at found).
how_to_pass: Add scheduled_at (ISO 8601 with timezone) to each campaign component. Schedule within platform golden windows. Space same-platform posts ≥2 hours apart. Prefer Mon–Thu for LinkedIn, Substack, and Reddit.

files.HOW.py: Golden hour timing gate — check scheduled_at against platform windows
files.AUDIT.py: Compliance audit — report warn rate over configurable lookback window
files.WATCH.py: Evolution scanner — emit strengthen verdict if >50% warn rate over 5+ fires
